_: M-Strata's own download-catalog pins (owner 2026-10-28: download cards for flint, raon-1-mini and Gemma 4 with its MTP draft file). Facts read from Hugging Face on 2026-10-28, never a download: each file's size and LFS SHA-256 (the resolve HEAD's X-Linked-Size and X-Linked-ETag) at the repository's commit (X-Repo-Commit), and the licence its model card names (the model API's cardData.license). Read as data by tools/secure/download_catalog.py (source m-strata); a later upstream change is a new pin here.
